test_cases.summary:
Verify version history loads consistently with large dataset
when a session has 100+ versions stored
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version History – Fast Load for Large Dataset

Scenario: Verify version history loads consistently with large dataset

Given a session has 100+ versions stored
When the user opens the Version History panel
Then the system should load the version list smoothly without UI freeze
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should load the version list smoothly without UI freeze
The behavior should be validated when the user opens the Version History panel.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system handles download interruption safely

The behavior should be validated when the network disconnects temporarily.
